title: Credit programmable wiring at its stated commercial-claim scope
statement: ROOT read returned Itera main/Tech pages claiming liquid-metal configurable substrates, real-component tests, internal-node probing and under-60-second reconfiguration. These remain maker claims rather than measured placement time, 3D assembly, electrical ratings, yield, delivered quotes or renewal life. No contact, waitlist, sign-up or images were followed. Programmable wiring alone is not a new operation against this predecessor.

evidence.quote: A. Governing sources and exact observation limits

requires: Actual part geometry, electrical function, mechanical retention, joining, neighboring heat, failed-part extraction, reconnecting and finite stock renewal belong to the useful assembly/rework operation. The thermal model assumes four constant-resistance diffusive metal-like bridges with Lorenz-law electronic heat flux, two lumped enthalpy/thermal nodes and an introduced melt fraction release criterion; other heat paths are not automatically removed.
provides: ROOT read returned Itera main/Tech pages claiming liquid-metal configurable substrates, real-component tests, internal-node probing and under-60-second reconfiguration. These remain maker claims rather than measured placement time, 3D assembly, electrical ratings, yield, delivered quotes or renewal life. No contact, waitlist, sign-up or images were followed. assumptions: Site binding yield is not functioning-device yield. Configurable-circuit company pages are maker claims, not a qualified delivered process or renewal life. The Lorenz model is not universal to real contacts; actual substrate, fluid, radiation and mechanical heat paths remain. Complete release/rejoin and useful device function are unconstructed. Numerical energy residuals and timestep checks validate only the declared calculation, not materials. No novel device, universal obstruction or advantage is claimed.
costs: Whole unchanged 14,647-byte ROOT note 6fee8fe4 and supplied 7,576-byte Python 94c52adc/5,009-byte JSON 4bb074c0 are published as evidence, not executed by Capital. Rates and material laws are introduced, not fitted to source materials. Morris, Itera and other exposures retain exact main/maker limits; no figures, cited-original, dataset, code or held-identity recovery. No physical experiment, spending, hardware, independent audit or new retrieval/model resource.
contract.units: Source-reported finite chemical, transport, financial, mechanical and measurement quantities at their stated assumptions; no Capital scientific execution.
obstruction: Construct and qualify actual heterogeneous assembly and selective replacement with owned parts, real retention, accessible connections, measured electrical function and full neighboring temperature trajectories. Compare ordinary rework, sockets, carriers, flex circuits and configurable wiring fairly. Proposed experiments remain unexecuted and require later authority for hardware or spending.

review.scope: Whole supplied original available derivations at exact stated scope; reported numerical execution is not physical qualification, a supplier quotation, novelty, an integrated invention or a new independent Capital audit.
